description: Compute IPv4 subnet details from CIDR notation entirely locally — no network call: network and broadcast addresses, usable host range, total usable hosts, subnet mask, and wildcard mask. /31 and /32 are handled per RFC 3021 (point-to-point / single host). Use this for IPv4 address planning. It does not query DNS or contact any host, so it is purely computational. Requires no API key and is NOT rate-limited (computed in-process). Returns the calculated fields as text.

cidr.description: IPv4 address with a CIDR prefix length 0-32 (e.g., '192.168.1.0/24'). IPv4 only; host bits may be any address inside the block.

name: subnet_calc
title: IPv4 Subnet Calculator
